segments.en: This discourse was said at the beginning of the winter of 5563. And there is a complete account regarding this — which will be elaborated somewhat elsewhere. See the words of the Sages in Brachos, p. 63b — on the verse: [Deuteronomy 27] "Hayom hazeh nihyais l'am [this day you have become a nation]." And so on.

segments.he: מאמר זה נאמר בתחלת חורף תקס"ג ויש בזה סיפור שלם ויבואר קצת במקום אחר:
